description: Fetch paginated buyer feedback and verified transaction reviews for a Goofish (Xianyu) seller, filterable by rating sentiment or unboxing photos.

maxReviews.description: Maximum buyer reviews to return per page (1-20, default 10).

page.description: 1-based page number for paginating seller reviews (default 1).

reviewFilter.description: Filter buyer reviews by sentiment or media ('all', 'positive_only', 'negative_only', or 'with_photos').

sellerIdOrUrl.description: Seller numeric userId, goofish.com URL, or fleamarket:// deeplink.

name: get_goofish_seller_reviews
title: Get Goofish Seller Buyer Reviews
